name: Check the balance of a specific member account
goal: Look up the member by member number and open their profile. The Accounts table has columns, in this exact left-to-right order: Acct No, Product, Balance, Opened, Status, History. A member can have several accounts. Find the ONE row whose Acct No column exactly matches the given account_no -- not the first row, not a guess. Once found, perform TWO SEPARATE reads against TWO DIFFERENT cells in that row: (1) read the Balance cell and output it as account_balance; (2) re-observe the page and read the Status cell (a different column than Balance) and output it as account_status. Do not read the same cell twice and do not confuse Balance with Status. If no row's Acct No matches account_no exactly, do not guess; call blocked.

inputs.name: account_no
inputs.description: Exact account number to read the balance/status of, as shown in the Acct No column.

outputs.name: account_balance
outputs.description: Balance of the account row whose Acct No matches account_no.

outputs.name: account_status
outputs.description: Status (e.g. OPEN, HOLD, CLOSED) of the account row whose Acct No matches account_no.

business_outcomes.description: The member number does not exist in the core system.

known_interstitials.description: Host-maintenance session notice that occasionally interrupts navigation.
